item.title: [LU-20390] Ubuntu 26.04 sanity-sec test_54 hung
item.description:

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment:

https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/7fd9330a-b822-47dc-970c-18794cf0d4b6

https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/22ece696-05ea-488f-8cb4-c98ea1af78fc
